mapper.insert: INSERT INTO radio_sessions (id, user_id, mood, story) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{mood}, #{story})
mapper.select: SELECT id, playlist_id, mood, story, era, genre, situation, desired_mood, video_type, preferred_artist, excluded_keywords, recommendation_source, dj_ment, comfort_text, novel_excerpt, tts_mode, tts_audio_url, is_public, published_at, created_at FROM radio_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, playlist_id, mood, story, era, genre, situation, desired_mood, video_type, preferred_artist, excluded_keywords, recommendation_source, dj_ment, is_public, published_at, comfort_text, novel_excerpt, created_at FROM radio_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO radio_recommendations (session_id, song_id, order_num, reason) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{songId}, #{orderNum}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT rr.song_id, s.title, s.artist, rr.order_num AS orderNum, rr.reason FROM radio_recommendations rr JOIN songs s ON s.id = rr.song_id WHERE rr.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY rr.order_num
mapper.update: UPDATE radio_sessions SET is_public = #{isPublic}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{isPublic} = true THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS radioSessionId, is_public AS isPublic, published_at AS publishedAt FROM radio_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT rs.id AS radioSessionId, rs.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, CONCAT( COALESCE(rs.mood, '감성'), CASE WHEN rs.situation IS NOT NULL AND rs.situation != '' THEN CONCAT(' · ', rs.situation) ELSE '' END, ' 라디오' ) AS title, rs.story, rs.mood, rs.situation, rs.era AS generation, rs.dj_ment AS djComment, rs.is_public AS isPublic, rs.published_at AS publishedAt, COUNT(rl.user_id) AS likeCount FROM radio_sessions rs JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id LEFT JOIN radio_likes rl ON rl.radio_session_id = rs.id WHERE rs.is_public = true GROUP BY rs.id, rs.user_id, u.nickname, rs.story, rs.mood, rs.situation, rs.era, rs.dj_ment, rs.is_public, rs.published_at
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, rs.published_at DESC
ORDER BY rs.published_at DESC

SELECT rs.id AS radioSessionId, rs.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, CONCAT( COALESCE(rs.mood, '감성'), CASE WHEN rs.situation IS NOT NULL AND rs.situation != '' THEN CONCAT(' · ', rs.situation) ELSE '' END, ' 라디오' ) AS title, rs.story, rs.mood, rs.situation, rs.era AS generation, rs.dj_ment AS djComment, rs.is_public AS isPublic, rs.published_at AS publishedAt, COUNT(rl.user_id) AS likeCount FROM radio_sessions rs JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id LEFT JOIN radio_likes rl ON rl.radio_session_id = rs.id WHERE rs.id = #{id} AND rs.is_public = true GROUP BY rs.id, rs.user_id, u.nickname, rs.story, rs.mood, rs.situation, rs.era, rs.dj_ment, rs.is_public, rs.published_at

SELECT rr.song_id AS songId, s.title, s.artist, COALESCE(s.generation, s.era) AS generation, s.genre FROM radio_recommendations rr JOIN songs s ON s.id = rr.song_id WHERE rr.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY rr.order_num
